title: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.30369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EEG) to provide timely guidance, continuously adapting a frozen vision-language model's inference on which items are task-relevant by jointly estimating per-source reliability without manual labels or offline training. Through three user studies, including two live deployments of an assistive agent driven by OLIVE in XR, we show that OLIVE Pareto-dominates prior test-time adaptation frameworks, achieving the highest convergence rate at comparable co

translated_title: 通过从在线行为与脑机接口证据中学习的XR智能体增强人类表现
translated_abstract: 我们提出了OLIVE，一个用于适配基础模型以在时间要求苛刻、高风险且动态变化的任务中提供实时辅助的框架。我们证明，被动EEG与行为证据在线融合后，能够有意义地扩展用户检测和参与目标的数量，超越其无辅助时的行动带宽。OLIVE同时从显式行为信号（用户在XR第一人称射击游戏中击落的目标）和隐式生理信号（注视锁定的EEG）中学习，以提供及时的引导，并在无需人工标注或离线训练的情况下，通过联合估计各信息来源的可靠性，持续调整冻结的视觉-语言模型对哪些项目与任务相关的推理。通过三项用户研究，包括两次由OLIVE驱动的辅助智能体在XR中的实际部署，我们表明OLIVE在帕累托意义上优于先前的测试时适应框架，在可比条件下实现了最高的收敛率……
tldr: OLIVE框架通过在线融合行为信号与被动EEG等脑机接口证据，实时适配冻结的视觉-语言基础模型，在XR高风险动态任务中为用户提供超越其自身行动带宽的辅助，并在帕累托意义上优于现有测试时适应框架。
en_tdlr: OLIVE is a framework that adapts a frozen vision-language foundation model in real time by fusing online behavioral signals with passive EEG evidence, extending users' target detection and engagement beyond their unaided action bandwidth in high-stakes XR tasks and Pareto-dominating prior test-time adaptation frameworks.
